infographic.title: How a Coriolis Meter Measures Mass Flow
infographic.alt: Infographic showing four steps of Coriolis mass flow measurement: drive, twist, time delay and output
steps: A drive coil vibrates the flow tubes at their natural frequency.
Moving fluid creates Coriolis forces that twist the tubes.
Pickoffs at inlet and outlet see a time delay between their signals.
Delta T gives mass flow; tube frequency gives density.
